description: Configuration panel remote (JavaScript and CSS assets beside remoteEntry.js) on signalk-nearlcrews-ui 0.11.1, measured at gzip level 9 the way snui-check-consumer measures it. Raised from 38501 bytes, the 0.9.0 figure, when the panel moved to 0.11.1: the release adds the panel label bundle, the repeat-announcement and freshness helpers, and the theme selector's visible group label and description, and the shared modules behind them reach the panel through the components it already renders. Re-record deliberately after reviewing what changed, so the percentage gate catches unexpected growth rather than a library upgrade.
